name: Arenas del Rey (Spain)
description: White field with a red diagonal band at the upper fly and a blue diagonal band at the lower hoist, charged at the centre with the crowned municipal arms of Arenas del Rey (an eagle, roundels and a bridge on yellow).
history: Municipal flag of Arenas del Rey; Spanish municipal flags are approved by the municipal council and the autonomous community and published in the regional official gazette.

features.role: Arenas del Rey arms — eagle, roundels and bridge
